blocks.text: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is a powerful technique used widely in chemistry, the polymer industry, the study of proteins and natural products, environmental monitoring and medicine. In chemistry it is used especially to identify organic compounds and work out their structures. Proton (1H) NMR and carbon-13 (13C) NMR are the two most common methods.
